en: The Triplet of the Wholesome, The Triplet of Seeing.

Conditioned by a state that is unwholesome and not to be abandoned by vision, an unwholesome state that is to be abandoned by vision arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three in the case of root; ... pe ... three in the case of non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is unwholesome and not to be abandoned by cultivation, an unwholesome state that is to be abandoned by cultivation arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three in the case of root; ... pe ... three in the case of non-disappearance.
In dependence on a state that is unwholesome and neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation, an indeterminate state that is neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation [arises].
A state to be abandoned by non-cultivation arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are three; under the predominance condition there are three ...
pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are three.
